body_es: La velocidad es la cantidad de trabajo (medida típicamente en story points) que un equipo Scrum completa en un sprint; se usa para proyectar cuánto trabajo se puede aceptar en futuros sprints y para estimar cuándo se entregará un conjunto de características. El throughput es similar pero se aplica a sistemas de flujo continuo como Kanban, midiendo elementos completados por unidad de tiempo. Aunque ambas métricas son útiles para planificación, no deben usarse como medidas de productividad de empleados ni como bases para comparaciones entre equipos de diferente composición o contexto.
body_en: Velocity is the amount of work (typically measured in story points) that a Scrum team completes in a sprint; it is used to project how much work can be taken in future sprints and to estimate when a set of features will be delivered. Throughput is similar but applies to continuous flow systems like Kanban, measuring items completed per unit time. While both metrics are useful for planning, they should not be used as employee productivity measures or as bases for comparing teams of different composition or context.
example_code:
# Velocity and Throughput Metrics (YAML)
velocity_tracking:
  sprint_history:
    sprint_1:
      planned_points: 40
      completed_points: 38
      velocity: 38
      items_completed: 12
      notes: "One story carried over"
    
    sprint_2:
      planned_points: 40
      completed_points: 40
      velocity: 40
      items_completed: 13
      notes: "On target"
    
    sprint_3:
      planned_points: 45
      completed_points: 42
      velocity: 42
      items_completed: 14
      notes: "Growing confidence"
    
    sprint_4:
      planned_points: 40
      completed_points: 40
      velocity: 40
      items_completed: 12
      notes: "Stable velocity"
  
  average_velocity: "(38 + 40 + 42 + 40) / 4 = 40 points per sprint"
  trend: "Stabilizing at 40 pts/sprint"
  forecast: "Next 3 sprints: 120 points total delivery"

throughput_tracking:
  kanban_flow:
    week_1:
      items_completed: 8
      average_cycle_time: "3 days"
    week_2:
      items_completed: 9
      average_cycle_time: "2.8 days"
    week_3:
      items_completed: 8
      average_cycle_time: "3.1 days"
    week_4:
      items_completed: 10
      average_cycle_time: "2.5 days"
  
  monthly_throughput: "8.75 items/week (35 items/month)"
  trend: "Slight improvement in throughput"

using_metrics_responsibly:
  do_use_for:
    - "Sprint planning (capacity planning)"
    - "Release forecasting"
    - "Process improvement identification"
  
  don_t_use_for:
    - "Individual performance evaluation"
    - "Team comparison or ranking"
    - "Strict productivity mandates"
